_doc: The master list of secret FORMATS removed from everything sent to a non-subscription model provider (docs/FREE-MODELS.md). One list, read by two engines that are the same file: company/tools/lib/outbound-scrub.js (the framework) and starnet/sidecar/outbound-scrub.js (StarNet patch 0022, a byte-identical copy; the station reads this file through env STARNET_SCRUB_PATTERNS). Each entry: kind (the word in the [REDACTED:<kind>] marker and in the redaction counts), re (a JavaScript regular expression source), flags (optional; g is always added), replace (optional template: $1..$9 are the pattern's groups, {R} is the marker; default: the whole match becomes the marker), minEntropy (optional: the secret part must have at least this many bits of Shannon entropy per character), needClasses (optional: it must mix at least this many of upper case, lower case, digits), notAfter (optional regex source tested against the 16 characters before the match: a hit there keeps it, e.g. a sha512- integrity hash). Order matters: the first entries are the most specific. Exact values of the company's own secrets/ files are removed before any of these (kind secret-file). Add a format here, never in code; the test is company/tools/tests/outbound-scrub.test.js.
